brief: 5 prompt engineering patterns that separate working AI from impressive demos.

slots.subtitle: Between a fragile demo and working system lies the discipline of structured thinking wrapped around the prompt.

slots.title: DEMOS
slots.subtitle: A flashy interface hides fragile logic. Production systems require repeatable outputs under edge cases and ambiguity.
slots.bodyText: Most prompt demos are cherry-picked on clean inputs. The real test is variance: temperature, context length, and user intent. Working AI is defined by what happens when the prompt meets chaos.
slots.calloutBody: Reliability is a design choice, not a model feature.

slots.title: FORCE
slots.subtitle: Before answering, make the model expose its logic. Explicit reasoning steps reduce hallucination and make errors inspectable.
slots.bodyText: Append 'Think step by step' is not enough. Structure the reasoning into labeled sections: observation, hypothesis, verification. This turns a black box into a debuggable pipeline.
slots.calloutBody: Visibility into process is as valuable as the output itself.

slots.title: EXAMPLES
slots.subtitle: Precise demonstrations of desired format and tone outperform lengthy instructions every time.
slots.bodyText: Provide three carefully curated input-output pairs that cover edge cases. The model interpolates patterns better than it parses abstract constraints. Show, don't tell.
slots.calloutBody: Three great examples teach more than thirty lines of preamble.

slots.title: PERSONA
slots.subtitle: Give the model a clear identity, then chain it with non-negotiable guardrails and output schemas.
slots.bodyText: A senior editor persona raises quality. A JSON schema constraint guarantees structure. Combine both: the persona provides style, the schema provides safety. Never rely on one alone.
slots.calloutBody: Creativity needs boundaries to become reliable.

slots.title: CALL
slots.subtitle: Models should reason, not calculate. Offload math, search, and memory to external functions with strict interfaces.
slots.bodyText: Define function schemas in the prompt and force the model to emit structured calls. This separates reasoning from facts, eliminating arithmetic hallucinations and stale knowledge.
slots.calloutBody: The best prompt knows exactly when to stop talking.

slots.title: VERIFY
slots.subtitle: Build reflection into the prompt itself. Ask the model to critique its output against constraints before returning it.
slots.bodyText: Add a final instruction: 'Review your answer for consistency with the constraints.' This meta-prompt layer catches format violations and logical contradictions without human intervention.
slots.calloutBody: Self-criticism is the cheapest test suite you can deploy.

slots.ctaBody: Pick one pattern and retrofit it into your highest-traffic prompt this week. Reliability compounds faster than model upgrades.
